remarks: Step into the timeless appeal of this classic 1939 Cape Cod home brimming with original character and unbeatable curb appeal. Perfectly sited in the heart of Westport's desirable Greens Farms neighborhood, this property offers a rare blend of historic charm, modern updates and exceptional convenience. You'll find as many reasons to LOVE IT TODAY as there are reasons to DREAM YOUR TOMORROW. Many will see it as move-in ready either for themselves (or to update over time) or move-in ready for their tenants. Renovators and flippers will find opportunity, and even Spec Builders since this is not a "designated" historic property and is available for new construction.FEATURES *Authentic 1930s character with well-preserved original details make it special.*Flexible, Practical Layout make Single-level living possible with first floor bedroom, ensuite bath ideal for guests, aging in place, or home office.*Spacious, Versatile Lower Level;SuperSize 2-car garage w/electric charging station.
